title: heterotheca ruthii
intro: Heterotheca ruthii, commonly known as prairie goldenrod, is a flowering plant native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in reducing pain, inflammation, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Heterotheca ruthii include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reducing swelling and pain, and as an antioxidant, protecting the body from free radicals and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Heterotheca ruthii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
